text:
Based on your love for Hitchcock and Kubrick, along with a desire for psychological thrillers from the Golden Age of Hollywood, I highly recommend watching "Rear Window" (1954). Directed by Alfred Hitchcock, this film is a masterclass in suspense and voyeurism, fitting perfectly with your interest in psychological mysteries. It stars James Stewart as a photographer confined to a wheelchair who suspects his neighbor of murder. The film’s intricate plot and tension are hallmarks of Hitchcock’s genius.

The country known for the Eiffel Tower is France.
